Being brought to the hospital by ambulance does not automatically mean you will be seen immediately or have the highest priority. In most hospitals, all patients, including those arriving by ambulance, are assessed (triaged) based on the severity of their condition. If your condition is life-threatening, you will be seen right away; if it is less urgent, you may have to wait. Therefore, you will be assessed and seen in order of priority.

Answer: A
